responsibility: Implements GCC’s internal software floating-point subsystem based on REAL_VALUE_TYPE and real_format. This file provides the core representation-level algorithms for constructing zeros/infinities/NaNs, normalizing significands, performing arithmetic, comparison, rounding, nextafter-style stepping, decimal and hexadecimal conversion, target-format truncation, and format queries such as HONOR_NANS/HONOR_INFINITIES, supplying the floating-constant semantics used by tree folding, fixed-point conversion, and target-independent constant evaluation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the core REAL_VALUE_TYPE algorithms declared in gcc/real.h, such as normalization, arithmetic, comparison, rounding, formatting, truncation, and floating-format property queries; unlike gcc/realmpfr.c, it is the native software floating-point engine rather than the MPFR bridge.
